rationale: Class 2 row comparison decides both flags. The current March 31, 2026 schedule lists Process Equipment at 3/6/2028 (table 31 row 15) and TerSera at 4/4/2030 (table 32 row 32). The flagged dates exactly match the comparative schedule rows: 9/6/2026 at table 71 row 17 and 4/4/2029 at table 72 row 31. This is a comparative-period extraction leak, not a bad structured XBRL date.
